basic_info.description: NOW w/ exclusive HUGE garage & shared yard. Welcome to 426 3rd Avenue - a generous 1BD (easy convertible to a 2-3BD) penthouse with a perfect blend of timeless architecture and modern luxuries creating the ultimate entertainer's pad. This elegant retreat boasts a thoughtfully renovated ensuite bathroom featuring a porcelain shower. The living room is the residence's centerpiece, tall ceilings boasts original coffered ceilings and meticulously preserved crown moldings from the early 1900s  tell a story of extraordinary craftsmanship and elegance. The dining room sets the perfect stage for unforgettable dinner and cocktail parties with its stunning crystal chandelier and seamless connection to the kitchen. With sleek Fisher & Paykel stainless steel appliances and a gorgeous original stained-glass skylight, the kitchen exudes an air of effortless refinement. The adjoining family room provides a warm social area for mingling with the chef over a glass of wine. A newly renovated large deeded limestone balcony featuring Flora Grubb landscaping, a custom redwood bench, and a cozy fire pit offers a peaceful evening under the stars. LG stacked laundry. Moments to boutique shopping, artisanal coffee shops, fabulous restaurants, parks and craft cocktail bars. Low HOA.
